canReconcile.text:
const canReconcile = Boolean(
    gate &&
      !activeTask &&
      !(terminalTask && gate.phase !== 'settled') &&
      (gate.phase === 'settled' ||
        (gate.phase === 'uncertain' &&
          (!gate.taskId ||
            matchingTask ||
            task.isError ||
            !access.canReadASIN)) ||
        (gate.phase === 'accepted' && (task.isError || !access.canReadASIN))),
  );
